pr_title: GameEngine: add first-release ADR visual validation
pr_body:
## Summary

Ports the first-release deterministic Editor Visual Validation suite for ADR0136, ADR0137, ADR0138, ADR0139, ADR0144, ADR0149, and ADR0153 onto current main after the original #673 branch diverged.

The ADR First Release suite launches each visual scenario in an independent Editor process and captures explicit preview lifecycle states, diagnostic navigation, live/stale Graph Debug provenance, working-copy conflict handling, hosted/enterprise backend posture, live observation status, and confinement posture.

This revision also preserves per-scenario Cargo/Editor logs and writes `summary.json` even after a partial capture failure, so the exact failing scenario and child-process diagnostics remain in the Actions artifact instead of being lost.

Supersedes the implementation branch used by Draft PR #673; do not merge both.
